source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of the unnumbered 'Nitrogen' section with Table 12.1, printed pages 273-274.

blocks.text: Nitrogen periodic table ke group 15 ka element hai. Industry (sanat) mein nitrogen aam taur par hawa ko itna thanda kar ke hasil ki jati hai ke hawa liquid ban jaye. Liquid nitrogen cheezon ko bohat tezi se thanda karne ke kaam aati hai. Laboratory mein nitrogen ammonium nitrite ke solution ko aahista aahista garam kar ke banai ja sakti hai.

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Kitab ki equation mein daen taraf sirf H₂O likha hai, is liye woh balanced nahi (baen taraf 4 H aur 2 O atoms, daen taraf 2 H aur 1 O). Sahi equation: NH₄NO₂(aq) → N₂(g) + 2H₂O(l).

blocks.prompt: Nitrogen hawa se kaise alag ki jati hai, aur laboratory mein kaise banai jati hai (exercise Q.2b)?
blocks.explanation: Industry mein hawa ko thanda kar ke (aur dabaa kar) liquid banaya jata hai; phir liquid hawa se nitrogen alag ki jati hai, kyun ke woh -195.8 °C par ubal kar pehle nikal aati hai. Laboratory mein ammonium nitrite ka solution aahista garam kiya jata hai: NH₄NO₂ → N₂ + 2H₂O.

items: Nitrogen: group 15, Z = 7, [He] 2s² 2p³, be-rang gas, boiling point -195.8 °C.
Industry: hawa ko liquid bana kar; laboratory: NH₄NO₂ garam kar ke → N₂ + 2H₂O.
